# I2 · Tiếp đón hôm nay

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › today · bảng tiếp đón chuyển thành thẻ theo giờ, Check-in / Vắng / Mời vào phòng

## Logic source
- Web: today · bảng tiếp đón chuyển thành thẻ theo giờ, Check-in / Vắng / Mời vào phòng
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `crm-ui.js` › today(); commands `ClinicStore.reception(id, status)` / `setStatus`.

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.Reception` ("reception") · app bar "Tiếp đón hôm nay"
- Composable: `ReceptionScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/operations/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/operations/OperationsGraph.kt`
- Registered by graph: `operationsGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `addDays`, `block`, `clearPreparedCrmBooking`, `crmQueue`, `initials`, `minutes`, `money`, `patient`, `preparedCrmBookingInput`, `reception`, `saveAppointment`, `staffContext`, `time`, `updateService`, `validate`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/operations/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/operations/OperationsShotTest.kt:21` → `pema-kmp/feature/operations/build/shots/I2-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/I2.png`

- DetailScaffold(title = "Tiếp đón hôm nay")  // back button, padding 20
- PemaExtendedFab("Đặt lịch mới")

## Business rules
- Entry point: the "Vận hành phòng khám" item at the end of each role's main screen (filtered by permission).

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Web seed data (DAY = 2026-09-20, P001 Nguyễn Minh Linh) instead of the canvas's illustrative names/dates.

## Gotchas / notes
- Only filter by doctor when the role is doctor (web `Staff.owns`); the owner sees all 31 appointments.
- The "Đặt lịch mới" FAB must be in DetailScaffold's `floatingActionButton` slot (already padded for the navigation bar).
